in_marathi.name: Bansilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Banana Tree, God of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bansilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bansilal is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘banas’ meaning ‘banana tree’ and ‘ilal’ meaning ‘God of Fortune’. This name is a reverence to Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as sitting under a banana tree.
